commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+5' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+3' A spell of possession for Sevilla in an attempt to control the game.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

87' The corner is swung in and Fernando Calero (Espanyol) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
87' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch for Ruben Vargas.
80' Here is a change. Juanlu Sanchez is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Leandro Antonetti (Sevilla).
79' What was Exposito (Espanyol) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
75' Some neat passing and movement from Sevilla as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
73' Substitution. Roberto Fernandez Jaen is replaced by Alejo Veliz (Espanyol).
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alvaro Tejero will be replaced by Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
69' Sevilla are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
68' Some patient build-up play from Sevilla as they look to unlock the defence.
67' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Pol Lozano and he is replaced by Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jofre departs the field of play to be replaced by Exposito (Espanyol).
66' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
65' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
64' The attendance is 33602.
64' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
62' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) replacing Peque.

61' 1 - 1 Loic Bade (Sevilla) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
59' The Sevilla players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
58' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
57' Celebrations are cut short for Sevilla as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
56' The referee gives a yellow card to Pol Lozano (Espanyol) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
55' The Sevilla players halt their celebrations as referee Adrian Cordero makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
54' Goal! Loic Bade (Sevilla) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
53' A corner kick by Sevilla is thwarted by the well prepared Joan Garcia (Espanyol).

53' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the roof of the net, but he can't get the power to direct it past Joan Garcia, who keeps it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sevilla.
53' Sevilla control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
51' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
50' Sevilla fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.
48' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
46' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
45+5' Yellow card. Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45+4' Sevilla hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
44' Alex Kral (Espanyol) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul. Sevilla are awarded the free kick.
44' The Espanyol players are exchanging some short passes.
41' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) has an opportunity, but isn't able to direct the ball into the net. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
40' The referee signals a corner kick to Sevilla.
38' Half-chance! Jofre (Espanyol) plays a pass into the box, but Orjan Nyland reacts well to snuff out the attack.
37' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:1.
34' Sevilla keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
32' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
27' Ball possession – 72:28.
24' What a chance! Loic Bade (Sevilla) rises high to connect with the resulting corner inside the box, but his bullet header rattles the right post.
24' Now Sevilla have a corner.

23' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) got in a good shooting position on the edge of the box and pulled the trigger. The ball flew towards the top left corner, but Joan Garcia punched it onto the post. Sevilla earn a corner.
22' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Problems for Manolo Gonzalez as Brian Olivan is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Carlos Romero (Espanyol) replaces him.
18' Brian Olivan (Espanyol) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
17' Sevilla are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.

10' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
9' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) makes a slide tackle, but referee Adrian Cordero blows for a foul.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sevilla.
3' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
2' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
